meta.title: A lot of a lot is refused, with a misleading message
gaps: The case does not specify the request body field name; trade_request_uuid is used to pass the lot RFQ uuid.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The buyer sends the trade create new lot request, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “A lot for one or more items already exists.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A lot of a lot is refused, with a misleading message

expected.message: A lot for one or more items already exists.
